Container.Name: prusa-connect
Container.Overview:
Self-hosted local Prusa Connect server for managing Prusa 3D printers on your LAN without relying on Prusa's cloud.
Notes: - Default WebUI & Printer API port is 8080. If port 8080 is already in use on your Unraid server (e.g., qBittorrent/SABnzbd), change the Host Port in the template to an open port like 8085. - First-Time Setup Code: On initial startup, the server generates a one-time setup code to claim admin ownership. Open the container logs after starting and look for "setup_code=XXXX-XXXX-XXXX".

Config.Name: WebUI & Printer API Port
Config.Description: Default port is 8080. Change the Host Port if 8080 is already in use on your Unraid server.

Config.Name: Config File (config.yaml)
Config.Description: Main server configuration file (seeded automatically on first run).

Config.Name: Config Overlay (config.d)
Config.Description: Machine-owned resource overlay and authorization database.
